summary: Joint tilt and CZ-phase gate-error bounds reopen the primorial gap-88 device question; measure the coherent fractions that decide it in simulation-designed probes before any hardware case.

reconciliation.note: An adversarial review of the single-family closure found the joint tilt and CZ-phase bound untested; the retained Kaggle record shows it reaches 2.61 and 2.84 standard deviations, so the device question reopens as a coherent-fraction question.

scope: The gap-88 phase-gradient tomography of the primorial cover on Heron r2: the joint coherent-bound record, simulation-designed probes of each path qubit's coherent tilt and each coupler's CZ conditional phase, a sampled-instance twirling model, and the signal and null interleave schedule. Provider jobs need their own approved cases.
next_action: Stage 1 voided on qubit 0 (results/live/PRIMORIAL_COHERENCE_FINDINGS.md). Blocked on pull request #516: after it merges, merge main, regenerate the backup-instance inventory and retention audit, extend the submitted-circuit comparison for job dbfdotnpc3tc739n8nm0, register the acquisition and claim, then decide with the user on a new case for a path that excludes qubit 0.

steps.action: Evaluate tilt, sx/x amplitude and CZ phase jointly at their gate-error bounds on the compiled gap-88 and null arms, per coefficient, with the identification-shot endpoint, arm mismatch, coherent-fraction scan and every-path sweep.
steps.acceptance: A retained Kaggle record and replay gate whose simulator reproduces every earlier single-family scenario to 1e-9, and a design document stating whether the bounds close the device question.

receipts.result: The bounds do not close the device question: tilt and CZ phase jointly at their gate-error bounds reach max_z 2.61 (best) and 2.84 (median) per coefficient, needing 53,363 and 76,596 shots per setting to identify against 2,803 and 3,169; each family alone stays below 1; static detuning of 30 kHz on all three qubits crosses 1 with the CZ-phase or tilt bound but stays at 0.43 and 0.45 with the atlas-fitted 0.04 rad CZ phase; all 226 working paths exceed 1 at their bounds.

steps.action: Simulate a repeated-CZ conditional-phase Ramsey and an identity sx-train tilt Ramsey on the snapshot paths and compute the shots that resolve tilt at 0.2 and CZ phase at 0.7 of their bounds at three standard deviations.
steps.acceptance: Each probe shows a first-order response to its family and none to the others within the bounds, with a shot and seconds estimate; a probe failing that is rejected. Stop before any provider job.

receipts.result: The probe circuits recover injected tilt, CZ phase, detuning and ZZ at once within 5.2e-5 rad, 3.8e-6 rad, 2.6 Hz and 1.3 Hz; noisy estimates stay unbiased within their standard errors; CZ phase at 0.7 of its bound needs 2 shots, tilt at 0.2 of its bounds at most 18, 5 kHz detuning at most 60 and 2 kHz ZZ 757 at three standard deviations.

steps.action: Sample twirled instances of the gap-88 and null arms, compile them to sx and rz, apply tilt to the compiled pulses and CZ phase to each CZ, and recompute the joint max_z.
steps.acceptance: A record giving joint max_z at tilt fractions 0.1 to 1.0 under sampled twirling; joint max_z above 1 at tilt fraction 0.3 rejects twirling as a sufficient mitigation.

receipts.result: Sampled samplomatic twirl instances reproduce the ideal law to 3e-7; 32 independent randomizations of the signal and null arms raise the joint max_z at the gate-error bounds to 5.4 and 6.5 against 2.6 and 2.8 untwirled, and 512 to 1.03 and 1.11, so twirling is rejected as a mitigation for the 32-randomization Sampler and the case runs untwirled.

steps.action: Set the signal and null interleave period from the arm-mismatch tolerances and the atlas drift rates.
steps.acceptance: A stated interleave period whose expected q0 frequency drift stays below 2.2 kHz, citing the drift source; a measured drift above that per period rejects the schedule.

receipts.result: Signal and null arms of a setting run in one batch column of 26.3 ms in the order gap-88, null, null, gap-88; no retained Kingston record measures a drift rate, so the case carries repeated-pair drift monitors whose noise floor is about 0.024 in the largest coefficient at 3200 shots.

steps.action: Run stage 1 (coherence probes) and, when its decision rule proceeds, stage 2 (gap-88 tomography) of results/live/PRIMORIAL_COHERENCE_CASE.md on ibm_kingston path 0-1-2 after the user approves the case and its fresh dry runs.
steps.acceptance: Retained runs with raw results, the probe summary, the --decide record, and either the gap-88 coefficients with identification and drift monitors or the stop verdict; a claim citing them.
